t: This bronze figure at the Stables Market in Camden Town is the statue of Amy Winehouse. It was sculpted by Scott Eaton and unveiled in 2014, three years after her death. Winehouse was a British singer and songwriter, known for her distinctive contralto voice and her autobiographical songwriting, which blended soul, rhythm and blues, and jazz. Eaton is an American artist whose work explores the human figure, in drawing, sculpture, photography and machine learning. Here, the two come together in a memorial to a singer who became an influential figure in popular culture.
